source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1091 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1091 was established by Ordinance No. 32274, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 24, 2022. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1091 is established on property generally located on the west line of Preston Road west of McCallum Boulevard. The size of PD 1091 is approximately 8.01 acres. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 1091A: conceptual plan.

(2) Exhibit 1091B: Tract 2 development plan. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Tracts
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.105. TRACTS.

This district is divided into two tracts (Tracts 1 and 2) as shown on the conceptual plan (Exhibit 1091A). (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.106. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.107. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Tract 1. No development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply.

(b) Tract 2. Development and use of Tract 2 must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 1091B). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.108. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those uses permitted in the LO(A) Limited Office District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the LO(A) Limited Office District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the LO(A) Limited Office District only by SUP is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to DIR in the LO(A) Limited Office District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) The following additional main use is permitted in Tract 2:

-- Restaurant with drive-in or drive-through service. [DIR] [May only operate between 6:00 a.m. and 9:30 p.m., Monday through Sunday.] (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.109. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.110. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

The yard, lot, and space regulations for the LO-1 Limited Office District apply. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.111. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.112. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.113. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.114. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) A “no through traffic” sign must be installed at the driveway entrance opposite McCallum Boulevard.

(b) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(c) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(d) Garbage collection may only occur between 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday through Sunday. (Ord. 32274)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1091.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 32274)
